purpose: Second fresh confirmation of the p = 23 recipe: held-out accuracy rises from <= 20% to >= 50% while the cycle-mean training CE does not decrease.
disclosure: The first pre-registered confirmation (CONFIRM_LOCK_p23.json; no decrease up to the first 90% held-out crossing) failed its >= 18/20 rule: joint 10/20, ND 10/20. Post hoc, on those 20 evaluation runs, the cycle-mean CE did not decrease up to the first 50% and 70% held-out crossings (ND50 20/20, ND70 20/20; largest drawdown to the 50% crossing 0.0006%), and held-out accuracy at the cycle-mean CE peak was 60.4-94.3%. This lock tests that post-hoc observation on 20 new pairs; none of the first cohort's runs enter this decision.
window_rule: unchanged from CONFIRM_LOCK_p23.json (selected on the 4 development runs only)
seed_rule: numpy.random.default_rng(20261002).integers(0, 2**63, size=(20,2), dtype=uint64); no overlap with the first cohort

primary_endpoints.P10: raw training-CE relative variation max/min - 1 <= 10% over every update of [t0, t1]
primary_endpoints.ND50: no loss decrease during the first half of recovery: T50 = first update > t0 with held-out accuracy >= 0.5 satisfies T50 <= t1 - 500; on [t0, T50] the two-update cycle-mean CE Lbar_t = (L_t + L_{t+1})/2 never falls more than 0.5% below its running maximum since t0, and Lbar(T50) >= Lbar(t0)
primary_endpoints.FIT: training accuracy 1 at every update of [t0, t1]

joint: P10 and ND50 and FIT and H20 and F04
decision_rule: CONFIRMED if the joint endpoint holds in at least 18 of 20 runs (two-sided 95% Wilson lower bound >= 0.70); otherwise reported as a failed confirmation. Either way the result is reported. A confirmed cohort is offered to the authors as a Figure 2 candidate; it does not replace Figure 2 automatically.
secondary: held-out accuracy at the cycle-mean CE peak on [t0, t1) >= 50%
illustration_rule: any single-run illustration uses confirmation pair 1
environment: cloud container, 2 CPU cores, Python 3.11.15, numpy 2.4.4, scipy 1.17.1; a 1500-update rerun of dev pair 3 reproduced the Lightning dev trace to <= 5.3e-16 relative
